label: Partitioned Indexes (Sync Gateway)
type: a Sync Gateway-side GSI index optimisation for deployments using Memory-Optimized Indexes that have grown too large for one index node - splits an index across configurably-numbered partitions, trading query fan-out cost for storage headroom. Available since Sync Gateway 3.3.
note: Its only stated access-control guidance is informal ('advanced users... typically Architects or Admins') - no Sync Gateway or Server RBAC role gates this destructive, hard-to-reverse operation, matching sgw:import-docs-setting's identical operator-discipline-only pattern in this same batch.
